audit.why: Lane difficulty (EVEN, diffRating 5.5/10) matches the 47.32% WR and the full/content level chart agreeing Bard 0-3, Skill 4-6.

Power spikes are already keyed to real cooldowns: Bard's Q (Cosmic Binding) 11/10/9/8/7s giving him the earlier stun window, and Sona's Crescendo 140/120/100s as the level-6 swing and late-game coin flip. spikes[] and breakdown.cooldowns both cite real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.trading is a verbatim concatenation of tradeGood + tradeBad (copy-paste bleed) and never mentions that Sona's Q (Hymn of Valor) grants her whole side a next-attack aura buff that applies on-hit effects, so armor stacking alone under-reads the poke trade.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule onhit-itemization: Sona applies on-hit through her Q aura buff — her side's damage scales with attack speed and on-hit items, not just raw magic pen, which changes what itemization actually answers her poke.

edits.before: Good trade: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all. Bad trade: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Good trade: bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all. Bad trade: standing in raw autos once Sona's Hymn of Valor (Q) aura is up — it buffs her side's next attack with on-hit effects, so armor alone reads the exchange wrong.

edits.before: If Sona’s duo opens the ledger, reset to vision and patience. A second kill retires your engage button — peel only and rebuild through vision and engage discipline.
edits.after: If Sona’s duo opens the ledger off her Aria of Perseverance (W) shield, reset to vision and patience. A second kill retires your Cosmic Binding (Q) — peel only and rebuild through vision and engage discipline.
